notes: Pins land exactly where you click again, and there are now two clearly different ones: a blue dot for where you are, a pink pin for where you're going (the old logo pins are a switch in Appearance). Search results no longer vanish when you click elsewhere, Enter goes to the closest match, and the panel matches the app's glass styling. On Mac, setup no longer reopens Tailscale repeatedly or gets stuck on "Waiting for you to sign in". The macOS build is Apple Silicon only (M1 or newer).
